basic_details.job_title: STPI Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Executive, Incubation Manager and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Chief Operating Officer (COO), Incubation Manager (IM), Assistant Incubation Manager (AIM) & Executive (Finance & Admin)

age_limit.age_details: Max 45 years for COO, Max 35 years for IM, AIM, and Executive.
age_limit.details: Chief Operating Officer (COO): Maximum age limit is 45 years. Incubation Manager (IM): Maximum age limit is 35 years. Assistant Incubation Manager (AIM): Maximum age limit is 35 years. Executive (Finance & Admin): Maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is permissible for deserving candidates.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's in Technology/Engineering or MBA for COO; Graduate for IM; Graduate for AIM; MBA (Finance) or Graduate in Science/Commerce for Executive.
qualification.details: Chief Operating Officer (COO): Bachelor's in Technology/Engineering (or equivalent degree) or Master in Technology/ Engineering/ Science or MBA from a recognized, accredited and reputed institute/university. Minimum 8 years of overall experience in the IT industry / start-up ecosystem as co-founder/founder/CxO and/or as an enabler of Start-up, Innovation & entrepreneurship ecosystem. Incubation Manager (IM): Graduate from a recognized university. Minimum 3 years of experience in incubation management & the startup/incubation ecosystem or the Information Technology (IT) sector. Assistant Incubation Manager (AIM): Graduate from a recognized university. Minimum 4 years of work experience including minimum 2 years of experience in incubation management & Incubation Ecosystem. Executive (Finance & Admin): MBA (Finance) and/or Graduate in Science/Commerce from a recognized university. Minimum 2 years of work experience for MBA / Minimum 4 years of work experience for Graduate of overall experience in Accounting & Administration.

salary_details.pay_scale: COO: Rs. 1,50,000/month; IM: Rs. 75,000/month; AIM: Rs. 50,000/month; Executive: Rs. 40,000/month.

selection_process: Screening by a duly constituted 'Screening Committee'. Personal interview before the duly constituted 'Search-cum-Selection Committee'.
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the STPI Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of STPI to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: STPI Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening by a duly constituted 'Screening Committee'. Personal interview before the duly constituted 'Search-cum-Selection Committee'.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the STPI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of STPI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for STPI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the STPI recruitment drive is 27 August 2026. Ensure you complete the process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in STPI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the positions of Chief Operating Officer (COO), Incubation Manager (IM), Assistant Incubation Manager (AIM), and Executive (Finance & Admin).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the COO post?
faq.answer: For the Chief Operating Officer (COO) position, candidates need a Bachelor's in Technology/Engineering or an MBA from a recognized institution. A Master's degree in Technology/Engineering/Science is also acceptable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Incubation Manager (IM) and Assistant Incubation Manager (AIM) posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both the Incubation Manager (IM) and Assistant Incubation Manager (AIM) positions is 35 years. Age relaxation may be provided for deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Executive (Finance & Admin) role?
faq.answer: The Executive (Finance & Admin) position offers a monthly salary of Rs. 40,000. This is a contract-based role.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the STPI posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening by a 'Screening Committee', followed by a personal interview conducted by a 'Search-cum-Selection Committee'.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for STPI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for these positions. Candidates are advised to check the official website for any updates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these STPI recruitments?
faq.answer: The recruitment for these positions is on a contract basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the contract agreement.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for STPI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location for this STPI recruitment?
faq.answer: The STPI recruitment for these posts is based in Nagpur, Maharashtra. Candidates applying should be willing to work in this location.
